nuggets.text: Neal Brown beat both LSU and Nebraska as Troy's head coach before taking over the Mean Green.
Tayven Jackson's older brother is Trayce Jackson-Davis, a former Indiana basketball star now with the Toronto Raptors.
North Texas is the fourth college stop for Tayven Jackson, after Tennessee, Indiana and UCF.
Jahiem White transferred from West Virginia to North Texas to reunite with his old coach, Neal Brown.
The Mean Green were one of two FBS teams returning zero starters this season, bringing in 70 newcomers.
The Mean Green went 12-2 last season and were ranked in the AP poll for the first time since 1959.
DATCU Stadium has three wind turbines and was the first newly built stadium to earn LEED Platinum certification.
The north end zone seats at DATCU Stadium form a V meant to resemble an eagle's wings in flight.
Stone Cold Steve Austin played college football at North Texas on a full scholarship.
Hall of Famer Mean Joe Greene played at North Texas, and his famous nickname is a nod to the Mean Green.
